proposed.name: Get Regular: Poop Tracker
proposed.subtitle: Gut Health, IBS & Food Diary
proposed.promotional_text: Log poop, meals and symptoms in seconds. See your daily Gut Health Score, spot food patterns, and bring a PDF Doctor Report to your next GI appointment.
proposed.description:
Get Regular is a gut-health tracking app for iPhone and iPad. Log meals, bowel movements (Bristol Stool Scale, from a photo or by manual entry) and symptoms, then see daily Gut Health and Nutrition Scores, weekly pattern insights and a doctor-ready PDF report.

Built for people dealing with bloating, constipation, diarrhea or IBS who want to see what their meals, habits and symptoms have in common, and to walk into a doctor's appointment with real data instead of guesses.

WHAT YOU CAN LOG
• Poop: Bristol Stool Scale type by photo or by manual entry (no photo required). Optional privacy mode for stool photos. Log no-go days without breaking your streak.
• Meals: by photo or text, with editable ingredients and one-tap re-logging.
• Symptoms: bloating, pain, gas, urgency and more, with simple taps.
• Drinks and water, supplements, medications, notes and time on the toilet.
• Period dates, so you can see cycle-related changes.
• Calories: optional, off by default.
• Backdate entries up to 7 days.

WHAT YOU GET BACK
• Daily Gut Health Score (based on your last 7 days of entries) and Nutrition Score.
• Weekly Digest: patterns across your food, stool and symptom history.
• Charts and a monthly heatmap to compare good and bad weeks.

WITH A SUBSCRIPTION
• Doctor Report: a PDF with bowel patterns, Bristol scale history, symptom frequency, food–symptom patterns, nutrient patterns and cycle data, ready to share with your gastroenterologist, GP or dietitian.
• Gut Check: ask questions about your own logs, like what has shown up before your worst bloating days.
• Experiments: guided self-tests, such as cutting dairy for a week, with daily tracking.
• Recipes matched to your symptoms and goals.

YOUR DATA
Meal and stool photos, text, symptoms and chat messages are sent without your name or email to OpenAI's API for analysis, and OpenAI does not train on API data. Photos are not stored on our servers; only the results are saved. Delete your account and data in the app at any time. Full details: getregular.com/legal/privacy-policy

GOOD TO KNOW
• iPhone and iPad only (iOS 15.1 or later). No Android app.
• Get Regular supports wellness tracking. It does not diagnose, treat or replace medical care. See a doctor for blood in stool, unexplained weight loss, night-time symptoms, or a lasting change in bowel habits.

Get Regular is made by Get Regular Health, Inc.

Subscriptions: Get Regular offers auto-renewing monthly and yearly subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.getregular.com/legal/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.getregular.com/legal/privacy-policy
